data.honestTitle: What we don't know, we say plainly
data.honestText: Every result has a date, sources and confidence. When data is missing, e.g. clouds covered the satellite image, we say so instead of guessing.
data.methodLink: How we calculate and what we leave out

cost.a: Nothing. The parcel check and result are free.

account.a: No. Parcels and the result are in the page address – save the link or bookmark it to come back.

number.q: Where do I get the parcel number?
number.a: From the land register extract or the agricultural tax decision. The village name and number are enough, e.g. “Dąbrowa 12”. You can also point to the parcel on the map.

aid.q: Is this a drought aid application?
aid.a: No. It is a hint for you and your adviser on what to do with water in the field. It does not replace the committee assessment or an aid application.

accuracy.a: Satellite images show your field, but not every day (clouds). Weather comes from a model for the area and soil maps are general. With the result we give the confidence and what we don't know.

privacy.a: We do not collect personal data: we do not ask for your name, address or phone. We only store the result for the parcel (number, crop and day) so the report link works.

cta.text: Free, no account, for any parcel in Poland.
